episodes.title: A Kingdom Unto Itself
episodes.summary: Michael Smyth lands in the New World on an HBC ship and is ordered by Lord Benton to the frontier in search of fur trader Declan Harp.

episodes.title: Little Brother War
episodes.summary: While Douglas and Malcolm Brown negotiate a loan with wealthy Samuel Grant, their brother Cedric Brown kidnaps a Lake Walker boy as trade leverage; Emberly takes a big risk that puts her in Benton's crosshairs

episodes.title: Mushkegowuk Esquewu
episodes.summary: After an unprovoked attack on their camp, Machk leads the Lake Walkers to retaliate against the Brown Brothers; Harp sets out to find the truth while tensions increase.

episodes.title: Wolves
episodes.summary: An unexpected arrival to Fort James puts Lord Benton and Chesterfield on edge; Emberly conspires to rid herself of a problem; Michael is shocked when he sees someone from his past.

episodes.title: The Disciple
episodes.summary: Captain Johnson closes in on Benton and the fort is reinforced with soldiers as Harp and Benton come face to face; Emberly makes a move to control Chesterfield.

episodes.title: The Gallows
episodes.summary: Chaos ensues at Fort James when Michael and Sokanon conspire to free Harp from Benton's grip.

episodes.title: Dead Reckoning
episodes.summary: With a price on Harp's head, Fort James fills up with bounty hunters. Emberly and Chesterfield conspire for the good of the Fort. Michael and Sokanon struggle to keep the Black Wolf in business, as Grant and Carruthers compete for supremacy.

episodes.title: Wanted
episodes.summary: Bounty hunters find a prize in the North. Benton sails to England at the mercy of Everton, but makes a new friend. Michael has a plan to make the Black Wolf more money. Carruthers and Grant vie for the attention of a French Marquis, and Emberly finds herself in danger of losing her independence.

episodes.title: The Wolf and the Bear
episodes.summary: Sokanon and Michael are surprised by an unexpected reunion; Michael formulates a plan to steal from the HBC; Chesterfield turns the screws on Emberly.

episodes.title: Mutiny
episodes.summary: Harp travels to Montreal to do business with Elizabeth Carruthers; Michael and Sokanon arrive in Fort James to put their part of the plan in place; life has gone from bad to worse at the alehouse.

episodes.title: Cannonball
episodes.summary: Michael digs the tunnel as Chesterfield conducts live drills. Emberly returns to Fort James to discover what Chesterfield has done to her alehouse. Elizabeth Carruthers lets Douglas get close and comes face to face with Grant.

episodes.title: Keetom Takooteeoo Maheekun (The Return of the Wolf)
episodes.summary: Chesterfield reels from the theft of the pelts and searches for Harp. Michael meets with Pond and is faced with a hard choice when Sokanon arrives. Josephette and the Brown Brothers unite against Grant, and Harp must deal with enemies on all sides and make new alliances in the Season 2 finale.

episodes.title: The Low Road
episodes.summary: While Harp treks north chasing Lord Benton, Michael forms a new alliance and the Hudson's Bay Company sends a pitiless agent to reassert its power.

episodes.title: La Fin Du Monde
episodes.summary: In Montreal, Michael tries coaxing Grant and the Brown brothers to join his alliance. In the far north, Harp closes in on his quarry.

episodes.title: Satanazas
episodes.summary: Harp commandeers a vessel and pursues Lord Benton across the Atlantic. Michael's duplicity comes to light as he tries to close the deal with Kamenna.

episodes.title: All for All and None for One
episodes.summary: In Scotland, Grace confronts a ghost from her past. On the frontier, Sokanon seeks an ally for her mission and Michael doubles down on his gamble.

episodes.title: House of the Lord
episodes.summary: Lord Benton leverages Grace in his cause with the Hudson's Bay Company. Harp discovers a betrayal. Sokanon faces a perverse imprisonment.

episodes.title: The Sins of the Father
episodes.summary: While the new alliance teeters on collapse, Sokanon's crusade leads to bloodshed. Harp invades Lord Benton's castle and faces a dark temptation.
